newsitem.title: UK: Rare doll collection fetches $4.7 million.
newsitem.headline: Rare doll collection fetches $4.7 million.

text.p: One of the world's most important collections of rare dolls was sold at auction on Friday for a total of three million pounds ($4.7 million), Sotheby's auction house said.
The dolls were collected by Dina Vierny, a Paris gallery owner, over a period of 50 years.
"The collection is legendary - quite simply the most important and valuable ever offered at auction anywhere in the world," said Sotheby's dolls consultant Bunny Campione.
"Dina Vierny can truthfully claim to have the Rembrandts of the doll world."
The highest priced doll in the collection, a German-made Kammer and Reinhardt bisque doll from around 1909, sold for 108,200 pounds ($171,800).
The record price paid for a doll is the 188,000 pounds ($298,500) paid for another Kammer and Reinhardt that was made in Germany in 1909.
